en: This is a vintage postcard with a sepia-toned photograph on the front showing a large wooden house surrounded by trees, a dirt road in the foreground, a flagpole, and a tall utility pole. The back of the postcard features handwritten Swedish text, an address, a green Swedish postage stamp, and a circular postmark. Printed text on the front reads 'PARTI AF KYRKHMON. NJURUNDA. Förlag: Handl. A. Westberg, Njurunda.'
